# Query to the Ministry of Revenues — employment income tax schedule

> Revenues and Customs Authority. That body no longer exists under that name: its
> functions sit with the **Ministry of Revenues** (and, for customs, the Ethiopian

## Letter (English)

Dear Sir/Madam,

We operate a payroll system used by employers in Ethiopia to compute and withhold
employment income tax on behalf of their employees. Before our next live payroll run we
wish to confirm, in writing and from the authority itself, that the schedule we apply is
the one currently in force.

We ask this because our schedule was taken from **secondary sources — legal-firm and
payroll-provider summaries — and not from the Federal Negarit Gazeta text.** We do not
wish to rely on a secondary source for a statutory deduction.

### 1. Which proclamation is operative

Our system currently assumes that the employment income schedule of **Income Tax
Proclamation No. 979/2016** was **replaced** by **Income Tax (Amendment) Proclamation
No. 1395/2025**, with effect from **7 July 2025**.

**Please confirm, or correct:**

- a) that Proclamation No. 1395/2025 is the operative employment income schedule today;
- b) that its effective date for employment income withholding is 7 July 2025; and
- c) that the 979/2016 schedule ceased to apply to employment income from 6 July 2025.

### 2. The schedule we apply — please confirm band by band

Monthly employment income, Ethiopian Birr. Tax is computed as
`(taxable income × rate) − deduction`.

| Band | Monthly income (ETB) | Rate | Deduction (ETB) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 – 2,000 | 0% | 0 |
| 2 | 2,000.01 – 4,000 | 15% | 300 |
| 3 | 4,000.01 – 7,000 | 20% | 500 |
| 4 | 7,000.01 – 10,000 | 25% | 850 |
| 5 | 10,000.01 – 14,000 | 30% | 1,350 |
| 6 | above 14,000 | 35% | 2,050 |

**Please confirm each of the following, or supply the correct figure:**

- the **exempt threshold** (we apply 2,000 ETB per month);
- each **band floor and ceiling**;
- each **marginal rate**;
- each **deduction amount**; and
- whether any **further allowance or deduction** (for example transport, or a general
  employment allowance) must be applied before the schedule is used.

For reference, the schedule we previously applied — and understand to be superseded — was:

| Band | Monthly income (ETB) | Rate | Deduction (ETB) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 – 600 | 0% | 0 |
| 2 | 600.01 – 1,650 | 10% | 60 |
| 3 | 1,650.01 – 3,200 | 15% | 142.50 |
| 4 | 3,200.01 – 5,250 | 20% | 302.50 |
| 5 | 5,250.01 – 7,800 | 25% | 565 |
| 6 | 7,800.01 – 10,900 | 30% | 955 |
| 7 | above 10,900 | 35% | 1,500 |

### 3. Why the difference matters, concretely

The exempt threshold moved from **600 ETB to 2,000 ETB** per month. An employer who
continued to apply the older schedule after 7 July 2025 therefore over-withheld. Examples,
computed with the two schedules above:

| Monthly gross (ETB) | Tax under 979/2016 | Tax under 1395/2025 | Over-withheld per month |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2,000 | 157.50 | 0.00 | **157.50** |
| 3,000 | 307.50 | 150.00 | 157.50 |
| 5,000 | 697.50 | 500.00 | 197.50 |
| 10,000 | 2,045.00 | 1,650.00 | 395.00 |
| 14,000 and above | — | — | **550.00** (the maximum gap) |

The proportional effect is heaviest at the bottom: an employee earning 2,000 ETB per month
would have had **157.50 ETB — about 8% of gross — withheld on income that is now exempt.**

### 4. Correcting an over-withholding

Where an employer has over-withheld employment income tax for one or more months since the
amendment took effect, **please advise:**

- a) whether the employer is required to **refund** the excess to the employee, or whether
  it is **offset** against future monthly withholding, or whether the **employee must
  reclaim** it directly from the Ministry;
- b) the **period** over which any correction must be made, and any deadline;
- c) how the correction should be **declared** — whether by amending the original monthly
  declarations, or by adjustment in a current declaration, and on which form;
- d) whether any **interest or penalty** attaches to the over-withheld amount or to a late
  correction; and
- e) what **record** the employer must retain and supply to the employee.

### 5. Ongoing notification

Finally, please advise how an employer may be **notified of future changes** to this
schedule — a subscription, gazette notice, or published circular — so that we are not again
dependent on secondary summaries.

We would be grateful for a written response. We are happy to supply any further detail, and
can attend in person if that is more convenient.

Yours faithfully,

«Name»
«Title»
«Company legal name»
TIN «Taxpayer Identification Number»
«Phone» · «Email»

> This is a working translation of the English letter above, produced without a native
> Amharic legal reviewer. Tax terminology in particular (`ተቀናሽ`, `የግብር ተመን`, `ከግብር ነፃ`)
> should be checked against the Ministry's own published wording before this version is

ለክቡር የገቢዎች ሚኒስቴር፣
«የሚመለከተው ዘርፍ»

ጉዳዩ፦ **በሥራ ላይ ስላለው የሠራተኛ ገቢ ግብር ተመን ማረጋገጫ፣ እንዲሁም ከተገቢው በላይ ስለተቀነሰ ግብር አያያዝ**

ክቡራን፣

እኛ በኢትዮጵያ ለሚገኙ አሠሪዎች የደመወዝ ክፍያ ሥርዓት እናቀርባለን፤ በዚህም የሠራተኛ ገቢ ግብር ተሰልቶ ይቀነሳል።
ቀጣዩን የደመወዝ ክፍያ ከመፈጸማችን በፊት፣ እየተጠቀምንበት ያለው የግብር ተመን በሥራ ላይ ያለው መሆኑን ከባለሥልጣኑ
በጽሑፍ ማረጋገጥ እንፈልጋለን።

ይህን የምንጠይቀው ተመኑን ያገኘነው **ከነጋሪት ጋዜጣ ኦሪጅናል ጽሑፍ ሳይሆን፣ ከሕግ ድርጅቶችና ከደመወዝ አገልግሎት
ሰጪዎች ማጠቃለያ በመሆኑ ነው።** ለሕጋዊ ተቀናሽ እንዲህ ያለ ሁለተኛ ደረጃ ምንጭ ላይ መመሥረት አንፈልግም።

**፩.** ሥርዓታችን በአሁኑ ወቅት የሚከተለውን ይወስዳል፦ የአዋጅ ቁጥር **፱፻፸፱/፪ሺ፰ (979/2016)** የሠራተኛ ገቢ
ተመን በአዋጅ ቁጥር **፩ሺ፫፻፺፭/፪ሺ፲፯ (1395/2025)** ተተክቷል፤ ተፈጻሚነቱም ከ**ሐምሌ ፯ ቀን ፪ሺ፲፯ ዓ.ም
(7 July 2025)** ጀምሮ ነው። ይህ ትክክል መሆኑን እንዲያረጋግጡልን እንጠይቃለን።

**፪.** ከላይ በእንግሊዝኛው ክፍል የቀረበውን ሰንጠረዥ — **ከግብር ነፃ የሆነውን ጣሪያ (፪ሺ ብር)፣ የእያንዳንዱን ደረጃ
ወሰን፣ የግብር ተመን እና ተቀናሽ መጠን** — እባክዎን ደረጃ በደረጃ ያረጋግጡልን ወይም ያስተካክሉልን።

**፫.** ከግብር ነፃ የሆነው ጣሪያ ከ**፮፻ ብር ወደ ፪ሺ ብር** ከፍ ብሏል። ስለሆነም ከሐምሌ ፯ ቀን ፪ሺ፲፯ በኋላ የቀድሞውን
ተመን የተጠቀመ አሠሪ ከተገቢው በላይ ቀንሷል ማለት ነው። ለምሳሌ በወር **፪ሺ ብር** የሚያገኝ ሠራተኛ፣ አሁን ከግብር ነፃ
በሆነ ገቢ ላይ **፩፻፶፯ ብር ከ፶ ሳንቲም** ተቀንሶበታል።

**፬.** ከተገቢው በላይ የተቀነሰ ግብር ሲኖር፣ እባክዎን የሚከተለውን ይግለጹልን፦ አሠሪው ለሠራተኛው **ተመላሽ**
ማድረግ አለበት ወይስ ከሚቀጥለው ወር ክፍያ ላይ **ይቀናነሳል**፤ የማስተካከያው **ጊዜ ገደብ**፤ በየትኛው **ቅጽ**
መታወጅ እንዳለበት፤ **ወለድ ወይም ቅጣት** ይኖር እንደሆነ፤ እና አሠሪው ምን **ማስረጃ** መያዝ እንዳለበት።

**፭.** ወደፊት በዚህ ተመን ላይ ስለሚደረግ ለውጥ **እንዴት ማሳወቂያ ማግኘት** እንደምንችል እባክዎን ይንገሩን።

በጽሑፍ ምላሽ ቢሰጡን በጣም እናመሰግናለን። ተጨማሪ መረጃ ለማቅረብ ዝግጁ ነን።

ከሰላምታ ጋር፣

«ስም»
«የሥራ መደብ»

## Where these figures come from

Every number above was read from the code, not from a document:

| Claim | Source |
|---|---|
| Current ladder (1395/2025) | `api/app/Services/Payroll/TaxCalculator.php:41-52` — `CURRENT_BRACKETS` |
| Superseded ladder (979/2016) | `api/app/Services/Payroll/TaxCalculator.php:63-71` — `SUPERSEDED_BRACKETS` |
| Effective date `2025-07-07` | `api/app/Services/Payroll/TaxCalculator.php:74` — `AMENDMENT_1395_EFFECTIVE_FROM` |
| Formula `(income × rate) − deduction` | `api/app/Services/Payroll/TaxCalculator.php:93` |
| Both ladders seeded, effective-dated | `api/database/seeders/TaxBracketSeeder.php:26-39` |
| Amendment applied to deployments | `api/database/migrations/2026_08_29_000001_apply_income_tax_proclamation_1395_2025.php` |
| Schedule came from secondary sources | `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md:12` |

Constants are stored in **cents**; the letter states Birr. The over-withholding table was
computed from the two constant arrays using the calculator's own formula, not copied from
any document.

> **One correction, recorded rather than quietly fixed.** `ENTERPRISE_ROADMAP.md` item 4.3
> cites the over-deduction as *"~140 ETB/month"* at a 2,000 ETB salary. Computed from the
> constants, it is **157.50 ETB** — which is also the figure `docs/DEPLOYMENT.md:12`
> gives. The letter uses 157.50. The roadmap row is not edited here.
